multiply_skel_states: multiply two skeleton state tensors to compose their transformations with broadcasting support
inverse_skel_state: compute the inverse of a skeleton state tensor for undoing transformations
transform_points_with_skel_state: apply a skeleton state transformation to 3D point coordinates using transform_points
slerp_between_skel_states: perform spherical linear interpolation between two skeleton states at a given t parameter
blend_skel_states: blend multiple skeleton states together using weighted averaging with the blend function
